# Made once with the last format-7 build (21 Nov 2026, before each clip had its own LFO: format 8), to keep a project
# as that build saved it for app/tests/cliplfo.txt: proj_v7.img. Run from the repository's top:
# app/build/host/ghettomachine_host app/tests/fixtures/make_v7.txt OUTDIR (with the format-7 build only; kept for the
# record)
wait 600
# ---- T2's LFO: its destination one on (PITCH), DEPTH 20, the rate up two
turn ALGO 1
wait 30
expect trk 2
tap LFO
wait 30
expect page 7
spin K4 1
wait 30
spin K3 20
wait 30
spin K2 2
wait 30
expect lset2_7 1
expect lset2_8 20
expect lset2_1 66
# ---- the drums' LFO (the LFO page stays): the bass drum's second knob, DEPTH 12
turn ALGO -1
wait 30
expect trk 1
expect page 7
spin K4 2
wait 30
spin K3 12
wait 30
expect lset1_7 1
expect lset1_8 12
tap SAVE
wait 400
expect projfmt 7
expect dirty 0
flash_dump app/tests/fixtures/proj_v7.img
